After an unusually long three-week wait, several new beta updates are now being pushed out to developers, including iPadOS 27 beta 5. Here are the details.

iPadOS 27 beta 5 and more Apple updates now available

The public release of iOS 27 is roughly one month away. That usually means the beta release cycle is about to accelerate.

Apple today has rolled out beta 5 of iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27 and more.

Right now only developers can download and install these new updates. However, if Apple follows its usual pattern, public betas of these software versions should be available within a day or two.

At this stage of the beta cycle, we don't expect to find any major user-interface changes in Apple's software. Instead, August is typically when two main things happen with Apple betas:

  • New betas arrive more frequently, usually once a week, but with noticeably fewer changes
  • Apple's focus shifts to bug fixes and performance improvements

Apple has emphasised that iOS 27 and the rest of the lineup bring performance gains over the previous generation.

Although to some degree that has already been achieved in the betas, expect Apple's new software to run more smoothly and have more bugs squashed in beta 5 and the weeks ahead.

That said, if any new features or notable changes do turn up in today's update, we'll let you know.

Have you spotted any new features in iPadOS 27 beta 5 or the other updates? Let us know in the comments.
